quote: Located in the municipality of Armenia in the department of Sonsonate, Opico Power is our most recent commitment to contribute to the generation of clean and non-polluting energy based on solar sources. Inaugurated in 2020, it counts on 12,834 last-generation photovoltaic modules … Opico Power generates 5.2 megawatts (MWp)
note: Opened AES El Salvador Opico Power plant page (5.2 MWp / 2020 inauguration).
